style.name: Tessera & Lime
style.line: broken umber contours and hand-painted tessera joins
style.shading: flat fresco planes with sparse tile shadows
style.style_block: STYLE: A hand-drawn digital fusion of Roman fresco and mosaic. Broken umber contours surround flat chalk-lime and terracotta forms; small irregular painted tessera shapes cluster at architectural edges while open ground remains broad matte pigment. Mineral blue and pale turquoise carry water, vermilion carries hostile fire, dull ochre carries stone and bronze. Shading is flattened fresco colour planes with rubbed plaster gaps, never realistic volume; ornament has civic gravity but the mood is sun-bleached captivity. The mosaic is a drawing language inside the scene, not a photograph of a wall or a framed historical artifact.

style.name: Salt & Scribe
style.line: fine nervous pen with broken edges

Shadows are sparse hatch groups and dilute ink pools; large untouched paper shapes keep routes and action legible. Narrow, wiry figures and economical architectural marks create a secretive, brittle, observant mood. No polished comic outlines or smooth rendered gradients.

style.palette: aubergine, soot, electric turquoise, ember orange
style.shading: hard cel shadows with concentrated painted glow
style.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital dark-fantasy ink with tapered luminous brush contours over deep aubergine and soot masses. Electric turquoise water and ember-orange fire are small concentrated painted light sources; stone has muted mauve planes, and pale bone highlights reveal the silhouettes. Use hard cel-shadow shapes and spare scratch marks, with isolated brush-glow edges rather than broad bloom. Sparse islands of detail float against quiet darkness, giving a charged occult and rebellious mood. The camp remains magically suppressed, lit only by ordinary lamps and painted rim light. No neon signage, science fiction or three-dimensional rendering.

ACTION: Draw an overhead tactical action-RPG fight on a broad sandy Roman arena floor, with small foreshortened combatants seen from above, open paths between them, and a thin rim of stone wall at the screen edges. At lower centre a Water mage faces straight UP the screen with both hands reaching toward enemies: immediately ABOVE her head is an inverted-U cyan magical shield arc, opening DOWN toward her, protecting her front while the sand BELOW and BEHIND her is completely bare. An orange fireball from the enemy mage at upper right bursts into a compact white spark on the TOP edge of this cyan shield arc; separately, a thin cyan needle from the player's outstretched hand travels diagonally toward a shield-bearing soldier at upper left. A slinger farther left and a cinder hound to the right create spaced threats, with a small jagged red-and-black warning patch off to the right; each fighter is small within the broad overhead floor, and every effect has its own clearly readable path. All figures, spell marks and terrain are hand-painted parts of this single game-view illustration; leave quiet strips along the top and bottom for later interface labels.

CONSTRAINTS: An original Roman-era elemental-mage prison game, drawn digitally by hand as a complete two-dimensional illustration. Roman-inspired tunics, sandals, limewashed masonry, terracotta, bronze collars and ward stones; invented people and symbols only. Entire scene in focus, clear silhouettes, readable at a reduced game-screen scale. No three-dimensional rendering, photography, modern equipment, existing franchise designs, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, panel grid or decorative outer frame.

ACTION: A wide overhead illustrated navigation map of the guarded mage camp, a complete walkable enclosure with branching paths and small collared adult inhabitants, no combat or spellcasting. Arrange a staff-training yard at upper left, a dry round cistern at upper centre, a sunken sparring pit at upper right; a market of awnings at middle left, a communal bread table and gathering square at the centre, a monumental barred arena door at middle right; a cluster of patched living tents at lower left, and a fogbound camp boundary with a secluded meeting path at lower right. Make each destination a distinct recognizable landmark with empty ground nearby for later code-drawn labels; salt ward posts and patrolling guards communicate confinement without obscuring routes. Leave calm space along the top for the day time-slot strip and along the bottom for destination information; draw only the map, all text and time-slot controls are added in code.

style.name: Rain on Travertine
style.palette: ivory, lavender, moss, ultramarine, diluted ochre
style.shading: translucent wet washes with paper highlights
style.density: airy open compositions with pooled detail
style.style_block: STYLE: Hand-drawn digital watercolour on cold-pressed ivory paper, translucent wet-on-wet washes, pigment blooms and bleeding architectural edges. Very selective graphite marks anchor the small figures; lavender shade, moss cloth, diluted ochre stone and ultramarine water leave much paper white, with a small burnt-orange accent for hostile fire. Detail pools at silhouettes and landmarks while the ground dissolves into airy open washes. White-paper reserves keep effects and routes distinct. Mood is melancholy, fragile and contemplative; avoid opaque gouache, heavy outlines and smooth computer-rendered volume.
